snippet.title: 12 PM Break: Toonie Tuesday by Decay
snippet.description:
Set of 5 high-intensity maps. Absolute ton of fun, definitely got killed, a lot.... a lot. Once I got the groove though, couldn't stop. Fun combat scenarios and layouts without being "bash you in the face impossible.", and instead just "bash you in the face, but you'll be fine."

Link to topic on Doom World:
